title: CBSP21-GATE-002: record the merge-blocking enforcement contract after making the manifest gate required
intent: The CBSP21 manifest gate was previously proven capable of failing closed, but it was not a required context in ruleset 15875552, so a failing gate did not prevent merge. This sprint made `CBSP21 Patch Manifest Gate` required, witnessed both directions on the real PR path, and records the resulting enforcement contract in docs/CBSP21.md. Documentation and manifest only; the ruleset change is a GitHub configuration action captured as PR evidence, and no workflow YAML or gate script was modified.
behavior_change: None in this repository patch. No workflow, CI script, gate algorithm, coverage threshold, manifest schema, or manifest-discovery logic is modified, and no production source is touched. The behavioural change — CBSP21 becoming merge-blocking — is a GitHub ruleset configuration change applied outside the repository tree and evidenced in the PR body and in docs/CBSP21.md.

diff_articulation.what_changed: docs/CBSP21.md gains a Merge Enforcement section and a corrected CI Workflows table. The old table listed four workflows by filename with inaccurate one-line purposes and no check contexts; it is replaced by a table keyed on the emitted GitHub check context, with trigger, draft behaviour, and required-for-merge status per workflow, plus a note explaining why only one context is required. The new Merge Enforcement section states the enforcement mechanism (ruleset 15875552, not classic branch protection, which 404s by design), the three-way merge contract for covered/uncovered/absent results, the required contexts, the deliberately unchanged adjacent settings, draft behaviour, a diagnosis table for missing or skipped checks, and the CBSP21-GATE-002 witness in both directions.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: No document stated whether CBSP21 was enforced or advisory. docs/CBSP21.md described the protocol and listed workflow filenames but never named the emitted check contexts or connected them to branch protection, and .cbsp21/patches/README.md covers manifest discovery and format only — it makes no merge-enforcement claim, so it is deliberately left unmodified. The distinction matters because the gate had been failing correctly for months while not blocking anything.

commands_run: TC-01 workflow inventory: four CBSP21 workflows enumerated from origin/main with triggers, job names, draft conditions, and continue-on-error status. None sets continue-on-error.
TC-02 exact check contexts grounded from real runs, not inferred from filenames: 'CBSP21 Patch Manifest Gate' (cbsp21_gate.yml) and 'cbsp21-patch-input' (cbsp21_patch_input_gate.yml).

Path-filter check: cbsp21/ = 0 files, cbsp21/patch_packets/ = 0 files, scripts/cbsp21/ = 3 files, .cbsp21/ = 73 files. Confirms the coverage-gate and packet-format workflows cannot serve as repository-wide required contexts.

TC-03 before-state: GET repos/HanzoRazer/luthiers-toolbox/rulesets/15875552 -> required contexts = ['Fence Checks (Blocking)'] only; strict=false; approvals=0; bypass_actors=[]. Classic branch protection GET /branches/main/protection -> HTTP 404 (rulesets in use).

Configuration change: PUT rulesets/15875552 adding context 'CBSP21 Patch Manifest Gate'. Payload built programmatically from the before-state with assertions that strict stays false, approvals stay 0, bypass_actors stays [], and the rule-type set is unchanged. Re-read from GitHub after the PUT (not the PUT echo) confirmed required contexts = ['Fence Checks (Blocking)', 'CBSP21 Patch Manifest Gate'] with all invariants intact.

TC-16 negative merge-block witness: disposable PR #264, base 428649c0, head 65c0982c, one undeclared file. CBSP21 Patch Manifest Gate FAIL, Fence Checks (Blocking) PASS, mergeable=MERGEABLE, mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED. Real merge attempt refused: HTTP 405 'Repository rule violations found - Required status check "CBSP21 Patch Manifest Gate" is failing.' main unchanged at 428649c0 before and after. PR closed unmerged, branch deleted and not reused.
TC-17 / TC-20 positive witness: this patch declares its own file set and is admitted by the gate it makes blocking.
TC-12 no continue-on-error in either CBSP21 blocking workflow; TC-14 coverage threshold unchanged at 0.95; TC-15 gate algorithm unmodified; TC-19 no runtime or production source diff.
scripts/ci/check_cbsp21_gate.py and scripts/ci/check_cbsp21_patch_input.py run locally on this branch -> PASS

files.intent: Record the merge-enforcement contract, correct the CI workflow table to key on emitted check contexts, and capture the blocking witness in both directions.

architecture_scan.acknowledgement_notes: Documentation-only repository patch. The constitutional change is the ruleset configuration, which is evidenced rather than committed because GitHub ruleset state has no repository representation; before/after configuration, exact contexts, date, branch, and verification results are recorded in the PR body and in docs/CBSP21.md. Scope was held narrow by decision: only one context was made required, the two path-filtered workflows were recorded but neither required nor repaired (requiring them would deadlock unrelated PRs), the draft condition on cbsp21-patch-input was left in place as intentional design, and strict, approvals, and bypass_actors were left untouched. No bypass flag was introduced and none exists.
